_doc: Source for scripts/build_paste_bundles.py. Each bundle is one round: a self-contained PowerShell text the PFM copies from its raw page and pastes into Windows PowerShell ISE (F5). It writes the files, then opens the 90-161.Z Deployer (a window; text prompts if no window can open): steps run one by one with a live log and PASS/FAIL counts, then one results folder (Rounds\\<round>: a report file plus copies of the PDFs, to attach to one e-mail; zips do not cross the boundary) and a summary for the clipboard. It runs only the steps inside it (PFM 3A). A step's "default" may be {passed, paths}: the step is ticked only when those files changed since the round that passed it; after a round passes it, set passed to the new hash (PFM 14 Nov 26). Never hand-edit scripts/gov/paste/*.ps1: change this file or the sources and rebuild.

bundles.title: Round R13: rights probe flow delivered and guided by the Deployer; seal prep searches all Inbox folders and Junk E-mail; site setup r2 (seals library fix, waits for the probe result); clearer log text

steps.name: T11 Rights probe: import and run the flow
steps.note: You import and run one flow in Power Automate (about 5 minutes, an estimate). The Deployer supplies the file and the address.
guide: 1. Select Open in browser. Power Automate opens; sign in with your CAC if asked.
(If the flow "90161Z T11 Rights Probe r3" is already in My flows, go to step 5.)
2. Select My flows > Import > Import Package (Legacy).
3. Select Upload. In the File name box press Ctrl+V (the file path is on the clipboard), then select Open.
4. For each connection (SharePoint, Office 365 Users, Office 365 Outlook), select your existing connection,
or Create new if you have none. Select Import.
5. Open "90161Z T11 Rights Probe r3" and select Run. Enter:
Site address: the new site.  Coworker e-mail: a regular member of the site (not an owner).
Wing group e-mail: the group that gives wing members access (leave empty if none).
Office mailbox e-mail: the office shared mailbox.  Then select Run flow.
6. Come back here and select "Done: the run has started". The round continues; the site setup step
collects the probe result when the flow finishes (it waits up to 15 minutes).
If the address is wrong for your tenant, correct it in the box; the Deployer remembers it.

steps.name: T07 Seal preparation
steps.note: Reads the seal images from T07\Seals or from the "90161Z T07 seals" e-mails, then prepares each one for the renderer.

steps.name: T16 Site setup
steps.note: Asks for the site address and a CAC sign-in, checks and sets the site settings, uploads the seals, and collects the probe result.

steps.name: T15 Environment inventory (read-only)
steps.note: Records this computer's software and settings. Changes nothing.

steps.name: T01 Renderer test
steps.note: Renders the sample publication in Word as a draft and as a final PDF (Word steps take a few minutes).

steps.name: T16 SharePoint connection test (read-only)
steps.note: Asks for the site address and a CAC sign-in, then lists what this account can do on the site. Changes nothing.
